conclusion: A successful http_busy observation with running1/pending0 means the HTTP200 JSON response contained one queue_running list item and zero queue_pending list items. It does not mean a Python process classifier guessed there was one Comfy job. Source inspection finds no count-arithmetic bug and cannot establish whether an actual reported item was current, stale, from a scheduled/old submission, or served by the intended application.

count_semantics.method: Bare urllib.request.urlopen URL call (normal GET path); no POST/mutation call in this branch.
successful_reply_requires: JSON top level type exactly dict
queue_running and queue_pending values type exactly list
shared observation time budget still positive at subsequent checks
same expected boot and unchanged MemTotal across observation
count_semantics.busy: Either list length nonzero => http_busy; both zero => http_idle.
count_semantics.item_validation: List items are not inspected or validated; lengths count items even if an item's own shape/content would not represent an active physical computation.
stored_evidence: SHA256 of exact raw HTTP body
count_semantics.not_stored_by_queue_helper: Raw queue content, job identifiers, user/client identity, timestamps, prompts and scheduled/old-job origin are not returned by _queue.

endpoint_identity.established_by_source: Fixed initial loopback address, port8188 and /queue path; successful response status200 and two typed list fields.
not_established: No listener PID/executable/cgroup or Comfy source/version binding on successful HTTP path.
No authentication token, application-specific signature or server identity handshake.
No final response URL/geturl equality check in reviewed source.
No explicit custom opener/no-proxy/no-redirect policy in reviewed source; no claim that a redirect/proxy actually occurred.
No response freshness timestamp, job state, GPU activity or submitter/scheduler provenance is validated.
endpoint_identity.scope: These are source limits, not evidence that the intended endpoint was impersonated, redirected, stale, cached or incorrect.

system_services_authority.role: Exact root-owned Ubuntu Pro apt-news.service and esm-cache.service recognition when an otherwise uncertain Python cwd must be assessed during connection-refused absence scans.
system_services_authority.not_role: It neither changes HTTP queue counts nor authenticates the HTTP8188 server, filters queue items, or whitelists running Comfy jobs.
system_services_authority.absence_branch: Only proven ECONNREFUSED (not HTTPError/non200/malformed JSON/timeout) permits two fresh listener/process absence scans. That branch returns absent_confirmed with zero/zero or raises ambiguity; it does not create http_busy1/0.

controller_policy.required_idle: comfy_state in {http_idle, absent_confirmed} AND running == pending == 0.
controller_policy.first_busy_sample: One successful nonzero HTTP sample immediately fails Original read-only Comfy idle gate. No debounce, count trend, grace period or calendar reservation is evaluated.
controller_policy.memory_order: Idle is checked before reserve/floor evaluation. A busy failure can retain required_available_bytes:null even though the observation includes current MemAvailable; that null is not evidence of memory shortage.
controller_policy.reserve: R=max(24GiB,ceil(MemTotal/5)); initial floor adds entire fixed2GiB cap, runtime floor R. Gate unchanged.
controller_policy.runtime_sampling: Preexec/readiness and runtime loop call same host gate. Runtime loop sleeps1s after work, so observations are sampled with work-dependent gaps, not continuous exclusion.
controller_policy.calendar_or_user_reservation: Neither observer nor host gate accepts a reserved time window, user intent or asynchronous reservation confirmation as an input.

possible_in_principle: A different server able to return the same HTTP200/list schema at the selected path is not distinguished by this observer.
A server may retain/report a list item although physical computation has finished; the observer does not independently verify item lifecycle or GPU activity.
A positive but brief queue snapshot is sufficient by the declared admission contract, even if a later snapshot is idle.
false_positive_assessment.distinction: A genuine nonempty running list is busy according to this existing contract. Whether that corresponds to a real current compute job or the user's reserved window requires evidence outside these three sources; no such evidence was read.
false_positive_assessment.actual03_actual04: No actual03/04 files or raw/private queue response was opened for this review. Parent-provided aggregate busy1/0 reports were used only as the question, not re-audited.
false_positive_assessment.current_corroboration: The parent's current listener metadata supports the expected Comfy process; a different-server explanation remains only an unproven source-level possibility, not a supported diagnosis.

disposition: Keep original observer/controller gate unchanged. Do not infer who submitted work, whether jobs were old/scheduled, or that the user's reservation was ignored from this source-only result.

root_current_listener_corroboration.interpretation: Parent's separate already-recorded socket/process metadata supports a real ComfyUI-shaped listener at this current snapshot. No new socket/proc/API probe was performed by this reviewer.
limitations: Does not map any queue list item to this process or establish actual03/04 historical listener identities.
No queue item, job ID, submitter, timestamp, scheduler, prompt or GPU activity was inspected.
The observer's source itself still does not perform this listener/process binding on successful HTTP observations.
